decision_impact: All 6 Triage Verdicts & Tiers Confirmed; New 3D, Splicing & Haplotype Gates Locked
headline: Six-Candidate Deep Compute, AlphaGenome, SuSiE Haplotype & 3D Cryo-EM/X-Ray Retrospective
prior_state_or_assumption: (1) S06: evaluated ARM-GoF variants as a uniform class without inter-protomer vs Cys311-wall 3D distances; (2) C001 & C022: omitted UNC13A Intron-31 retention ceiling and 6-cohort DNAJB2 TDP-43 splicing checks; (3) C006: lacked signed AlphaGenome #3 Intron-5 ISE polarity screening; (4) C015 & C018: left chr14q12 SuSiE eQTL phase unverified and treated C1q anti-head Fab vs ASO as domain-equivalent.
new_evidence_or_revision: (1) S06: full-length 7ANW/7DJT octamer geometry proves inter-protomer ARM(A)-TIR(H) salt-bridge contacts (3.07-5.47 A; p.E252K 3.07 A, p.R249C 3.09 A vs 37.8-65.4 A intra-chain) are invisible in monomeric AF2, yields a [MODEL_PRIOR] ~36% Binomial hetero-octamer residual NADase floor at 100x Kd in d_lock=6.5 carriers, separates Class II Cys311-pocket deformers (L223P, del226-232 AC=52, R267W AC=137 near Arg224/Glu264) from latch breakers, confirms <0.1% (~0.076%) validated GoF carriers in gnomAD v4.1 (PMID:34796871; PMID:34991663; vs benign P332Q AF=0.986%, 97 hom), and shows 0/12 ClinVar SARM1 records are single-gene SARM1 (6 opposite-strand SLC46A1 records); (2) C001: Brown 2022 MAJIQ reveals TDP-43-KD UNC13A Intron-31 retention (PSI 0.097->0.444, dPSI=+0.354, FDR=1.82e-15; Exon 31-32 0.791->0.461), implying a [MODEL_PRIOR] ~46.1-55.6% standalone Intron-20 ASO mRNA ceiling under severe TDP-43 loss above Keuss 2026's >30% synaptic rescue threshold (PMID:43015463); (3) C022: 0/6 TDP-43 cryptic/APA events (i3Neuron RNA log2FC=+0.092, p=0.124, padj=0.283) + 25/25 shared-exon single-gene ClinVar P/LP vs 0/25 in cytoplasmic DNAJB2b Zone A CDS; (4) C006: [MODEL_PRIOR] one-sided WT-context AlphaGenome screen predicts #3 chr20:63442302:C>G increases Exon 4-6 skipping +35.2% (+0.193; MN ATAC q=-0.99988) vs #2 Intron-4 UG (-0.052), flagging a putative Intron-5 ISE hazard; (5) C015: SuSiE-inf (purityMeanR2=0.988, COLOC H4=0.958, PMID:34873335) proves rs229243-A, x-anc lead rs229195-A (PIP=0.240), rs229194-A, and rs229143-A co-segregate in phase (gnomAD NFE AF=32.6-32.9%, EAS=60.4-61.3%) driving opposing MN (+0.048) vs myeloid (-0.22..-0.33; CD14+ q=-0.99986) SCFD1 effects; (6) C018: PDB 1PK6 (1.85 A, PMID:12960167) gC1q head vs AFDB cationic CLR stalk (26 Arg/Lys residues driving neuronal RNP uptake, PMID:38942014) splits anti-gC1q Fab from C1QA/B ASO.
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: (1) C006 & C001: reinforces C006's Tier-2 microwalk gate (#3 ISE vs ISS test) and pairs C001 Intron-20 #2 with Intron-31 ceiling accounting; (2) S06 & C022: adds 3' SLC46A1 avoidance and Cys311 vs TIR GoF profiling to #1 S06, and favors nuclear Intron-9 3'SS or DNAJB2a cDNA over Zone A CDS steric ASOs in C022; (3) C015 & C018: rules out pan-CNS SCFD1 knockdown in C015 and requires dual C3d + neuronal polysome profiling in C018.

decision_impact: C006 Moved to Tier 2 (#4/52); Multiplex Margin Target Calibrated (#3–#5)
headline: QRL-201 ANQUR Readout, CONQUR Pivotal IND & KCNQ2 Tier-2 Gate Calibration
prior_state_or_assumption: (1) KCNQ2 Tiering: placed KCNQ2 (C006) in Tier 1 ahead of wet-lab Intron-5 splice-enhancer/silencer microwalk proof; (2) Multiplex Mass: framed Stage 2 multiplex co-dosing around legacy 24–48 mg total intrathecal oligonucleotide loads.
new_evidence_or_revision: (1) Phase 1 ANQUR (NCT05633459): N=52 DRF at 3 mg/10 mg vs placebo and N=41 3 mg OLE showed Day-197 CSF pNfH -46% at 3 mg vs ~5% at 10 mg, while Day-253 10 mg ALSFRS-R slowing relied on post-hoc exclusion of the top baseline-NfL fast-progressor tertile; (2) Pivotal CONQUR & Benchmarks: US FDA cleared the pivotal CONQUR IND on 16 Nov 2026 (planned H1 2027), evaluated alongside single-agent intrathecal ASO benchmarks nusinersen (12–50 mg, DEVOTE PMID:41634391), tofersen (100 mg, VALOR PMID:36129998), and tominersen (PMID:31059641).
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Moves C006 (KCNQ2) to Tier 2 · Focused Gate First (#4/52, Keep · Core) alongside C001 (#3/52) and C002 (#5/52) pending a dense Intron-5 exon-inclusion microwalk and NHP verification of <=3 mg lumbar-to-BA4 motor-cortex delivery; replaces unvalidated 24–48 mg 3-plex loads with a 6–9 mg (<=3 mg/strand) multiplex polyanion/DRG margin target.

decision_impact: Keep · Core Reinforced (#3/52); Tier 2 Multiplex Gate Retained
headline: Human Neuronal UNC13A Cryptic-Exon Blockade Restores Evoked Synaptic Release
prior_state_or_assumption: Anchored UNC13A (C001) functional rescue on iPSC motor-neuron splicing and Munc13-1 protein restoration (Brown 2022 PMID:35197628; Ma 2022 PMID:35197626) without human electrophysiological rescue thresholds.
new_evidence_or_revision: Keuss et al. (2026, Nature, PMID:43015463, DOI:10.1038/s41586-026-11256-2) demonstrated that restoring >30% human UNC13A protein via Intron-20 cryptic-exon deletion or 2'-O-MOE ASOs rescues miniature and evoked AMPA EPSCs and MEA network synchrony across human cortical and spinal motor neurons. Isolated UNC13A rescue left STMN2 polyadenylation, KCNQ2 Exon-5 skipping, and ~10% postsynaptic mEPSC amplitude unrescued, confirming orthogonal compartment complementarity.
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Reinforces C001 (#3/52, Keep · Core, Bio #1) causal validity while retaining Tier 2 positioning behind sponsor-owned ICH M3(R2) single-entity GLP intrathecal tox on clean window #2 chr19:17642537-17642554(-) and Stage 2 rs12973192/rs12608932 genotype-stratified 2-plex vs 3-plex testing.

decision_impact: Keep · Core Retained (#1/52); Bliss, GoF & CD38 PD Gates Bounded
headline: SARM1 Parallel Bliss Lower Bound, Rare GoF Ceiling & Off-Target CD38 Fluid Guardrail
prior_state_or_assumption: Framed STMN2 + SARM1 combination around an indirect NMNAT2-epistatic MWC shift prior without bounding rare ARM-domain GoF residual NADase activity or ecto-CD38 background fluid cADPR.
new_evidence_or_revision: Evaluated clinical allosteric SIR2501 (NCT07765446 CIPN Ph2) and reversible orthosteric NB-4746 (NCT07369076) across three [MODEL_PRIOR] bounds: (1) 1.0x parallel microtubule plus-end Bliss survival additivity (Krus 2022 PMID:35767949; DOI:10.64898/2026.11.07.764673) to ~2–7x (med ~3x) NMNAT2-epistatic MWC dose-sparing; (2) ~30–40% residual NADase ceiling at 100x Kd in rare ARM-broken GoF heterozygotes (Gilley 2021 PMID:34796871; Bloom 2022 PMID:34991663); (3) ~5–10% selective cell-free fluid cADPR drop vs ~45–50% implied ecto-CD38 inhibition if cell-free plasma cADPR drops -50% (PMID:32087251; PDB 9TZY PMID:42156967).
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Retains S06 (#1/52, Keep · Core) while requiring Cys311Ala non-covalency verification, <1% SARM1 GoF carrier sequencing exclusion, enzymatic CD38 counter-screening, and unbound CSF trough PK.

decision_impact: Keep · Exploratory Retained (#2/52); Assay-Bridge & Cox SAP Sized
headline: CSF pNfH Platform-Bias Dilution & TRICALS-Adjusted Phase 3 Survival Sizing
prior_state_or_assumption: Modeled MIROCALS Phase 3 enrichment (CSF pNfH <=3,700 pg/mL) without quantifying Schoenfeld power dilution from cross-platform slope bias or survival power gain from Cox prognostic adjustment.
new_evidence_or_revision: Al Khleifat et al. (2026, J Neurol, PMID:42836993) showed inside MIROCALS (NCT03039673, PMID:40354799, N=220) that clinical TRICALS risk explains only r^2 = 12.7% of log(CSF pNfH) (-2LL = 928.25 vs 793.36) and surfaced 1.8x–4.5x MSD ECLIA vs BioVendor ELISA pg/mL bias alongside fully enrolled N=137 ALSTARS (NCT07161999, which omits CSF pNfH gating and blocks Treg CD28): (1) [MODEL_PRIOR] unbridged lower-reading bias dilutes 247-death Phase 3 power (80% at HR = 0.70) toward ~6–12%; (2) pre-specified TRICALS + log(CSF pNfH) Cox adjustment raises power to ~84–88% (noting <750 pg/mL n=20/220 had 0 deaths).
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Retains S07 (#2/52, Keep · Exploratory, Tier 1) and locks split-aliquot Passing-Bablok CLIA-to-BioVendor bridging (N>=120 ALS CSFs) as a Stage-0 prerequisite plus pre-specified TRICALS + log(CSF pNfH) Cox SAP adjustment.

decision_impact: Keep · Exploratory Retained (#23/52); Coupled CASM Washout Gate Added
headline: Stoichiometric PIKfyve–PI(3)P–LRRK2/CASM Coupling Narrows Pulsed Apilimod Window
prior_state_or_assumption: Evaluated pulsed q48h–q72h apilimod (C020) under a decoupled kinetic model assuming an occupancy dead-zone before vacuolation onset (~79% parameter-grid pass rate).
new_evidence_or_revision: Kuwahara et al. (2026, Life Sci Alliance, PMID:42994990) demonstrated direct, threshold-free PIKfyve -> +PI(3)P -> LRRK2 Rab10-pThr73 / ATG16L1 CASM recruitment alongside Drosophila C9orf72 secreted DPR data (DOI:10.64898/2026.11.09.765393). In [MODEL_PRIOR] pulsed q48h–q72h turnover simulations (>=55% substrate clearance and end-of-cycle stress <=0.05), removing the occupancy dead-zone cuts grid survival from ~79% (64/81) to ~30% (24/81) at matched 10–20 h repair and 0% (0/81) at slower 24–48 h postmitotic CASM washout.
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Retains C020 (#23/52, Keep · Exploratory) under Epistemic Asymmetry (continuous BID failed clinically in NCT05163886 / NCT06215755; pulsed q48h–q72h remains clinically untested) behind a 14-day human iPSC-MN CASM washout and intracellular + secreted DPR mass-balance kill-gate.
